newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's MIB bank say profits up by 60 percent.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's MIB bank say profits up by 60 percent.

text.p: Misr International Bank (MIB) said its net profits rose 60 percent in the first half of calendar 1996 to 64 million pounds from 40 million pounds for the same period of 1995.
The bank's total assets rose to 9,034 million pounds on June 30, 1996, from 7,823 million one year earlier.
State-owned Banque Misr owns more than half MIB's shares with 55.65 percent. The state's Misr Insurance owns four percent and Egyptian individuals own 11.35 percent.

Foreign investors include Banca di Roma International (10 percent), British Arab Commercial Bank (8.5 percent) Commerzbank and Central Hispano Americano Banco (jointly 7.875 percent) and Sakura Bank Limited (2.625 percent).
